material_soul.rationale: why this concept fits this industry and audience

dominant_60.psychology: warm alabaster — calm, tactile, not sterile white

structural_30.psychology: obsidian espresso — weight without dead black

accent_10.psychology: high-tension warm accent — appetite and urgency

color.shadow: tinted with the background hue — never dirty grey
